title: Equality of vertex and edge connectivity for cubic graphs
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph that is $3$-regular, meaning every vertex has exactly three neighbours. Then the vertex connectivity and the edge connectivity of $G$ coincide, $\kappa(G) = \kappa'(G)$.
replaced:
A simple 3-regular graph has \texttt{$\kappa$ = $\kappa$'}.

3.1.6 Show that if $G$ is simple and 3-regular, then $\kappa = \kappa'$.
